answer: In the Singapore Model AI Governance Framework 2nd Edition, repeatability refers to the internal repetition of results within one's organisation, meaning that an individual or team can reliably repeat their own experiment or results under the same conditions. On the other hand, reproducibility refers to the ability of an independent verification team to produce the same results using the same AI method based on the documentation provided by the organisation, indicating that different teams can achieve similar results under potentially different conditions.
